scope: Single real XTerm scroll pilot requesting hardware HEVC 4:4:4 on two owned X11 endpoints.
measurement_limits: The original XTerm workload uses foreground text on a black background. Its static metric describes green-channel glyph coverage and error for this raster, and the single trial is not a scored codec comparison or physical timing measurement.

workload.action: scroll up one row and insert new Unicode text beneath a fixed marker row

manifest.source: Mint xterm scroll source and X11 root capture
manifest.target: owned Ubuntu X11 viewer, HEVC 4:4:4 at 1:1

trials.scope: independent X11 software raster observations on separate machines over OpenSSH

static_cadence_analysis.scope_note: Observer glyph timing is viewer-local. Host window information is counted independently and does not identify individual encoder packets responsible for signature changes.
